mapper.insert: insert into ccip_bridge_record (id, message_id, user_address, token_symbol, token_address, from_chain_id, to_chain_id, source_tx_hash, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id, typeHandler=com.dripswap.bff.repository.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{messageId}, #{userAddress}, #{tokenSymbol}, #{tokenAddress}, #{fromChainId}, #{toChainId}, #{sourceTxHash}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, message_id, user_address, token_symbol, token_address, from_chain_id, to_chain_id, source_tx_hash, created_at from ccip_bridge_record where message_id = #{messageId} limit 1
